props.title: Pool of 100 ledger connections per payments pod
props.risk: Total connections grow with the number of pods, which nobody is tracking yet.

neighbours.name: PR-412 implements ADR-7 (Cap the ledger pool at 20 connections per payments pod), decided by Tomas Novak on 2026-09-28. It replaced ADR-3. It was motivated by INC-088. Its recorded risk: Under burst traffic, requests beyond the pool size fail immediately unless a bounded wait queue is added in front of the pool.
Cap the ledger pool at 20 connections per payments pod

sources.quote: Each payments-core pod keeps a pool of 100 ledger-db connections.
